title: Sell Mineral Rights in Millwood, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Millwood, PA | Westmoreland County
metaDescription: Millwood, PA mineral owners in Westmoreland County: we buy interests directly and explain your Marcellus and legacy oil and gas rights in plain language.
heroLead: Westmoreland County has a longer relationship with oil and gas than most people realize, and Millwood sits in a part of the county where both the old shallow wells and the newer Marcellus units have left their mark.
intro: Westmoreland's natural gas history actually predates the modern Marcellus boom by well over a century, with shallow wells dotting the county going back to the 1800s. Millwood and the surrounding townships have seen both eras, which means some deeds here carry old gas leases layered under newer Marcellus agreements.
We buy mineral and royalty interests around Millwood directly. We'll sort through whatever documents you have, old or new, and explain exactly what applies to your interest today.

sections.heading: Layers of Leasing History
paragraphs: It's not unusual for a Westmoreland County tract to have an old, shallow-well gas lease from decades ago still technically on the books, alongside a more recent Marcellus lease covering the deeper formation. Sorting out which lease governs which zone, and whether the old one has actually expired, is part of proper title work here.

The Marcellus and deeper Utica formations under this part of Westmoreland County have drawn steady operator interest, and pooled units around Millwood may include acreage from several smaller legacy tracts.

sections.heading: What the Westmoreland County Recorder Shows
paragraphs: We research your chain of title through the Westmoreland County Recorder of Deeds in Greensburg, checking for both older and more recent lease filings that might affect your parcel.
If we find an old shallow-well lease that's still technically active, we'll explain what that means for your deeper rights rather than assuming it doesn't matter.

sections.heading: A Clear Number, Explained Plainly
paragraphs: Once title and production history are clear, we give you a straightforward offer and walk through exactly how we arrived at it.

faqs.question: Does an old shallow-well lease affect my Marcellus rights?
faqs.answer: It can, depending on the lease's depth clause and whether it's still held by production. We check this specifically for your parcel rather than assuming either way.

faqs.question: My family's records only go back a generation or two. Is that enough?
faqs.answer: Usually. We can trace older history through the county recorder's own records even if your personal paperwork is incomplete.

faqs.question: Do you buy interests tied to older, low-volume shallow wells?
faqs.answer: We evaluate those on a case-by-case basis depending on production history and whether the tract also carries deeper Marcellus rights.
